title: Bite Toothpaste’s Genius $8M/Year Brand Positioning Strategy 🦷
description: Bite Toothpaste’s Genius $8M/Year Brand Positioning Strategy 🦷
transcript: Bite's genius eight million dollar a year brand positioning strategy and it's something almost every econ brand is missing right now. Most oral care brands market around fresh breath, wider teeth, cavity Protection. Bite went in a completely different direction. Sustainability, aesthetics, ingredients, lifestyle, being anti big toothpaste and and of competing with Colgate on better toothpaste. They created an entirely new category toothpaste tablets. Now suddenly the product became more shareable, more interesting, more premium, more content friendly, and especially creator friendly. And this is where the strategy gets genius. Their product looks different, which means every creator video is automatically going to grab a attention in the feed. That's why their TikTok and meta ads work so well right now. Then they layer in clean, minimalist branding, eco friendly messaging, luxury aesthetics, subscription offers, U G C, creator content, and bathroom counter visual appeal. They turn toothpaste into a lifestyle brand because when you own positioning, you can charge more, scale easier, get lower CAX, increase your retention and dominate attention without relying on discounts.
